verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair thing to ask of a SaaS analytics product, but direct probes found no such files: https://plausible.io/llms.txt and https://plausible.io/docs.md both return 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The Stats API docs are ordinary human-facing documentation, and the AI-referrer traffic tracking is a different feature, so neither counts toward this story.
